title: Rory and the Starlit Cedar Grove
verses:
The sun drifted down past the top of the hill,
And shadows stretched over the west,
The whispering cedars grew cozy and still,
As Rory was ready to rest.

Then Nia flew gliding far up in the sky,
To look for a path through the trees,
While Psittaco chirped from a branch up on high,
That swayed in the murmuring breeze.

Below in the moss, Ricky finished his play,
With eyes that were heavy and deep,
While Tilly walked gently to show him the way,
Where everyone snuggled to sleep.

Now Benny stepped forward with comforting grace,
His footsteps were heavy and slow,
He guided his friends to a welcoming place,
Lit up by a silver-moon glow.

Then Psittaco settled without any sound,
Safe into the warmth of the night,
While Rory sank down on the clover-soft ground,
Where fireflies twinkled with light.

The moon sprinkled silver across the cool stream,
The stars in the heavens shone clear,
And Rory slipped into a magical dream,
With all of his dino-friends near.
